answer: In this PoA design, bonded escrow makes each identity’s stake slashable, while evidence linking k coordinated equivocations triggers aggregate penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, hence O(k²). A sybil swarm therefore cannot dilute the cost across disposable keys: once coordination is detected, asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential-in-k multiplier to total capital loss. Whether the identities are labeled quartz, delta, and saffron or otherwise, splitting control increases exposure rather than reducing it.
